answer: Bind each identity to one verified employment attestation: the employer confirms the agent's role through a signed HR record, checked against a company registry. A sybil farm cannot mint a thousand workers - each fake needs a separate real employer willing to vouch, and a lotus of invented job titles wilts under one phone call to HR. One pearl of a genuine job buys one identity; the cost is the employer's reputation and the audit trail behind it, plus a dune of paperwork before activation. Limitation: it excludes freelancers and the unemployed, and it trusts employers not to sell attestations.
